effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] If this Digimon has [Agumon] in its digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Omnimon] or [Greymon] in its name (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon] or [DexDoruGreymon]), it gets +2000 DP.
